tokens.text:
Orbis palette (its own celestial identity)

Midnight navy #101827 · Deep indigo #292D50
Antique gold #D6AC68 · Celestial cyan #91DCE8
Warm ivory #F4EDE0 · Terracotta #C95851

Text on navy: ivory #F4EDE0, muted #9AA1C0 (passes 4.5:1), gold #D6AC68.
Ivory instrument panels keep it warm, not a dark dashboard. Brass frames + chart lines, no neon, no glass.

Type reuses Botanica's family so the hub reads as the same universe: Young Serif (display) · Figtree (UI) · JetBrains Mono (labels).

interactions.text:
Try it (press Play)

The orrery is the navigator — hover a world to raise it, click to dock its dossier on the right.
Botanica → Enter World launches a simulated transition (in the full build it opens the untouched Botanica OS).
Lithic / Aether / Ironworks → Preview only; they never open a non-existent world, and carry planned version numbers, not dates.
Move the pointer to parallax the starfield · Focus collapses the chrome · Settings drawer has motion + sound toggles.
The navigator's journal below is the personal dashboard.

scope.text:
Scope — Orbis only

This is the hub that wraps the existing Botanica OS. Botanica itself is NOT rebuilt or changed here: 'Enter Botanica' is a simulated launch, and the real Botanica OS canvas stays exactly as it was.

Lithic, Aether and Ironworks are future destinations with their own mini-identities (crystal, floating isles, ironworks) and planned versions — shown as worlds worth waiting for, not disabled cards.
